evidence.label: Avalanche consensus protocols
evidence.claim: Avalanche Snowman uses repeated validator subsampling and confidence thresholds to finalize linear-chain decisions.

evidence.label: Avalanche validator staking
evidence.claim: Primary Network validators are stake weighted and register a node ID, BLS key, and BLS proof of possession.

evidence.label: Avalanche node architecture
evidence.claim: Validators participate in Snowman/Snowman++ consensus while non-validating nodes can track chains without consensus participation.
